spans.s: ऋत्विज् [ṛtvij], a. Ved. Sacrificing at the proper season or regularly; -m. A priest who officiates at a sacrifice; यज्ञस्य देवमृत्विजम्
also; the four chief Ṛitvijas are होतृ, उद्गातृ, अध्वर्यु and ब्रह्मन्; at grand ceremonies 16 are enumerated.
Due, regular. अयं ते योनिर्ऋत्वियः Jāb.
Conforming to, or familiar with, ceremonial rules.
Being in the period most favourable to conception. -n. Menstruation.
